metadata.description: Abhijit's AI-agent skills: iOS dev loop, Linear PM, core workflow helpers

plugins.name: ios-dev
plugins.description: iOS development loop: simulator build + preview + screenshot delivery, device builds, TestFlight/App Store release automation

plugins.name: linear-pm
plugins.description: Linear project management conventions and slash commands: issue templates, agent-ready workflow, autonomous issue pickup

plugins.name: core-workflow
plugins.description: General dev workflow helpers: commit flow, skill contribution, team orchestration, image-parser and web-researcher agents, shellcheck-on-edit hook

plugins.name: second-wind
plugins.description: Set-and-forget orchestrator for long Claude Code runs: when the 5-hour usage limit pauses sessions, wind notices, waits for the reset, and resumes every tmux session — including overnight

plugins.name: prompt-craft
plugins.description: Turn rough prompts into deterministic specs and surface the right next step: /improve-prompt, /plan, debug/refactor/review lenses, a follow-up-suggesting Stop hook, and opt-in secret/format guardrails

plugins.name: portable-artifacts
plugins.description: Host-agnostic, offline, open-source artifact skills: static SQL + Vega-Lite dashboards with per-chart provenance, ELK-laid-out diagrams, HTML explainer pages and slide decks from typed sections, and spec-driven animated videos rendered to MP4

plugins.name: test-board
plugins.description: Test results band: passed/failed/skipped after every test run, next to the previous run of the same suite in the same worktree

plugins.name: session-compass
plugins.description: Session compass: what each session is building, where it stands and what it produced, as a compass band, a /compass pane and a compass_status tool
